author: NotPineapple203
body:
So guys here are three that I always consider when I take a screenshot and also things that I would consider while streaming a match.

1. Hide HUD, Use Cinematic Camera(Streamers), Focus on a certain player/part of the map (And not your sick parkour skillz)

2. Make sure there are no lighting glitches, if so try to fix

3. Remember: PEOPLE WILL WATCH/SEE THIS

Those are just my personal three. If you think that there should be more, feel free to comment your checklist!

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
He's being helpful, don't judge him :/

Not many people know how to screenshot properly and I've seen people use other resource packs.

@OP, another thing to consider is for people to not use resource packs for screenshotting maps. It's misleading towards spectators.
